We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts.

Facts: Wu obtains contract for construction of residential building for a government unit (工管所). He bribes officials (tied to "好处费") to get the contract without public bidding. He gives cash to officials. This is bribery: giving money to state staff for favorable treatment. The label should be "受贿" or "行贿"? The defendant is Wu, who gives bribes to state officials. So Wu is the briber, committing "行贿". The officials are recipients, but they are not being charged here. The prosecution says "吴某为谋取不正当利益，给予国家工作人员以财物" which is the definition of "行贿". So the crime is "行贿". However, the correction lessons mention "单位行贿;利用影响力受贿" vs "受贿". But here Wu is an individual (maybe a company) giving bribe to state officials to get contract for his own benefit. That's "行贿". Not "受贿". Also there is "单位行贿" if the bribe is given by a unit (company) rather than individual. Wu is an individual but he may be acting as a representative of his company (挂靠公司). The label "单位行贿" is used when the bribe is given by a unit (company) to a state staff. The facts: Wu挂靠上林县城乡建设工程有限公司 and signed contract. He gave cash. The prosecution says "吴某为谋取不正当利益，给予国家工作人员以财物". That is "行贿". The correction lesson: "Correct label 【单位行贿;利用影响力受贿】 (not 「[罪名]受贿;行贿;单位行贿<eoa>」): 关键在于辨别受贿方是以个人身份还是利用个人影响力为单位获取贿赂；本案中被告人利用与上级的关系为单位争取项目并收受单位贿款，属于‘单位行贿’和‘利用影响力受贿’，而不是普通的个人受贿或行贿。" That is about a case where the bribe is given to a person who uses influence to get money for a unit. Not our case.

Thus we label "行贿". The label list: maybe "行贿". The format: [罪名]行贿<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "受贿" for officials, but not in this case. Also "非法占有" not relevant. So final answer: 行贿.
